notes.title: Update before Summer Sale 2018
notes.content:
Hi everyone,

I pushed an update for the game to enable full controller support for both Windows and Linux. It was the top requested feature and I'm glad that I was able to add it in this update and before the upcoming Summer Sale 2018. Please check back as the game will have a very nice discount. 

 I would love to hear any feedback you guys may have.

Thanks,
Pedro.
